name: animated-menubar
title: Animated Menubar
description: A row of menus, like an app’s File and Edit menus.

changelog.summary: The tablet and phone menu panel scrolls reliably, even on pages with smooth scrolling.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette, menus included. With a Primary fill, the bar and item highlights take its primary colour.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: animation
props.label: Opening
props.description: How a menu opens from its trigger.

props.name: exitFast
props.label: Exit fast
props.description: Menus close faster than they open (60% of Duration).

props.name: switchAnimation
props.label: Moving over
props.description: What happens when you move to the next menu while one is open: the panel glides across, or closes and reopens.

props.name: contentAnimation
props.label: Content animation
props.description: How the new menu's items appear while the panel glides. Needs Moving over set to Glide.

props.name: slideDistance
props.label: Slide distance
props.description: How far items slide in when switching menus. Needs Moving over set to Glide and Content animation set to Slides in.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long opening, closing and gliding take, in seconds.

props.name: delay
props.label: Delay
props.description: Wait before the items start to appear, in seconds.

props.name: stagger
props.label: Stagger
props.description: Delay between one item appearing and the next, in seconds.

props.name: triggerHighlight
props.label: Menu highlight
props.description: Highlight that follows the pointer along the menu bar.

props.name: triggerHighlightColor
props.label: Highlight fill
props.description: Colour of the bar highlight. Not used when Menu highlight is None.

props.name: showChevrons
props.label: Chevrons
props.description: Shows a chevron next to each menu name that turns when it opens.

props.name: triggerRollingText
props.label: Rolling trigger text
props.description: Menu names roll to a second copy of themselves on hover.

props.name: openOnClick
props.label: Open on click
props.description: Menus open on click only; hovering the bar doesn't open them.

props.name: pressFeedback
props.label: Press feedback
props.description: Menu names squeeze slightly when pressed.

props.name: itemHighlight
props.label: Item highlight
props.description: Highlight on the item under the pointer inside a menu.

props.name: itemHighlightColor
props.label: Item highlight color
props.description: Colour of the item highlight. Not used when Item highlight is None.

props.name: selectionIndicator
props.label: Selection indicator
props.description: Mark shown next to chosen options in checkbox and radio items.

props.name: showIcons
props.label: Icons
props.description: Shows an icon before each item.

props.name: showDescriptions
props.label: Descriptions
props.description: Shows a second line of help text under items that have one.

props.name: rollingText
props.label: Rolling text
props.description: Item labels roll to a second copy on hover.

props.name: size
props.label: Size
props.description: Text and padding size of the bar and menus.

props.name: rounded
props.label: Roundness
props.description: Corner radius of the bar, the menus and their items.
